patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient has a 3-week history of fatigue, difficulty to concentrate, and dyspnea on exertion. He also experiences dizziness and digital pain that improves with cold. He has a long history of smoking.

Secondary_Symptoms: Digital pain that improves with cold

patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Smokes half a pack of cigarettes a day since he was 20.
patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: The patient denies any recent infections, bleeding disorders, or significant weight loss.

objective_for_doctor: Evaluate and diagnose the patient presenting with fatigue, difficulty to concentrate, and abnormal blood findings.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Doctor, over the past three weeks I’ve been feeling significant fatigue and trouble concentrating, along with shortness of breath when I exert myself. I’ve also had dizziness and pain in my fingers or toes that improves when I’m exposed to cold.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any involuntary movements recently—like twitching, jerking, shaking, or sudden movements that you can’t control? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: Doctor, no—I haven’t noticed any twitching, jerking, shaking, or sudden involuntary movements.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a **lump in your right breast that doesn’t hurt** and feels like it **moves a bit under the skin** when you touch it? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t noticed any lump in my right breast, and I haven’t felt anything moving under the skin.”

turns.doctor_question: When you press or gently tap around your belly button area, does it feel tender or painful? (yes/no)
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, when I press or gently tap around my belly button area, it doesn’t feel tender or painful.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been vomiting recently (yes or no)?
Have you noticed a lump or mass in your **right breast** (for example, a new or growing area you can feel)?
turns.patient_answer: “No doctor, I haven’t noticed any lump or mass in my right breast.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that the lenses in **both** of your eyes look **cloudy or hazy**, like you’re seeing through a fogged window? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “No doctor, I haven’t noticed that my eyes look cloudy or hazy—my vision seems the same to me.”

turns.doctor_question: In the past few months, have you lost weight without trying (for example, your clothes fit looser or the scale went down), even though you didn’t change your diet or exercise?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I haven’t lost weight without trying, and my clothes haven’t noticeably fit looser.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a **lump or mass in your right breast that doesn’t hurt** (painless), even if it’s small or you only feel it sometimes?
turns.patient_answer: “No doctor, I haven’t noticed any lump or mass in my right breast, and I don’t feel any painless area there—only the fatigue, trouble concentrating, breathlessness with exertion, dizziness, and finger/toe pain that improves with cold.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been pregnant recently, or is there any chance you could be pregnant right now?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I’m not pregnant, and there’s no chance of that—I’m a man. My main issues have been fatigue and trouble concentrating for the past three weeks, plus breathlessness on exertion, dizziness, and finger/toe pain that improves with cold.”
